scope: Kosovo medical discovery — University of Prishtina Hasan Prishtina Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: The Faculty of Medicine lists General Medicine as an integrated six-year, 360-ECTS programme leading to the title Medical Doctor.
The Faculty's official history says it was established within the University of Prishtina by a 17 June 1969 law and that collaboration with Prishtina Hospital was established in 1973.
The General Medicine department page describes objectives including clinical and laboratory skills and student exchanges, but does not state a current applicant-facing placement allocation.

holdReasons: No current official General Medicine tuition amount, currency, payment terms or academic-year fee schedule was found.
No current official admission call establishes international eligibility, required documents, intake timing or selection process for General Medicine.
No official programme page located in this pass establishes the teaching language or an English-medium route.
Without those primary sources, a public programme payload would risk inventing fee, language or admissions claims.
nextAction: Obtain the Faculty's current General Medicine admission notice and fee decision, ideally with the language of instruction and international-candidate route, before building payload.json or setting the ledger row to validated.
